notes:
BLOCKED on HELPER_MISSING: the pinned repository is a Gazebo Classic C++ plugin suite for PX4 MAVLink SITL/HITL, not a ROS node or an importable Python device. README.md:1 titles it "PX4 Gazebo Plugin Suite for MAVLink SITL and HITL"; README.md:5 says it "has no dependency on ROS"; README.md:12 says it is "designed to be used with the PX4 Autopilot". The card's family:ros/RosDriver is a scan artifact from the ROS build dependencies at package.xml:41-63 (gazebo_ros, mavros, mavros_msgs, roscpp), not the runtime shape.

PRIMARY CONTROL: GazeboMavlinkInterface is a Gazebo ModelPlugin (include/gazebo_mavlink_interface.h:137-146) whose MavlinkInterface opens QGC/SDK UDP sockets (src/mavlink_interface.cpp:57-73), a TCP simulator socket (:101-109) or a simulator UDP socket (:180-188), with mavlink_addr/mavlink_udp_port/mavlink_tcp_port settings (src/gazebo_mavlink_interface.cpp:470-490). Its OnUpdate polls MAVLink, sends sensor messages, handles actuator controls and publishes CommandMotorSpeed on Gazebo transport (src/gazebo_mavlink_interface.cpp:548-619; topic constants at include/gazebo_mavlink_interface.h:109-120). RosDriver binds only rosbridge ROS topics, services and actions (MHS/sdk/docs/ros-driver.md:5-9, 27-43); it cannot carry MAVLink, Gazebo transport or the GStreamer UDP camera path (models/fpv_cam/fpv_cam.sdf:89-92).

ONLY ROS ENDPOINT IN THE PARENT SOURCE TREE: gazebo_motor_failure_plugin is optional (CMakeLists.txt:40 sets BUILD_ROS2_PLUGINS OFF; build at :428-429). It creates an rclcpp node and subscribes std_msgs::msg::Int32 on /motor_failure/motor_number (include/gazebo_motor_failure_plugin.h:38; src/gazebo_motor_failure_plugin.cpp:60-67), stores the number (:81-83) and republishes it on the Gazebo transport topic /gazebo/motor_failure_num (header:39; cpp:75-78), which GazeboMotorModel consumes (include/gazebo_motor_model.h:51; src/gazebo_motor_model.cpp:155, 192-194, 282-298). There is no ROS publisher, service, action, acknowledgement or feedback. A RosDriver publication to it is transmission-only ({published: true, confirmed: false}) and has no stop. A read-only driver would subscribe to the plugin's input topic and observe other clients' commands, not the simulator; that is not a device observation. The 0 sentinel inside GazeboMotorModel means "no fail" (include/gazebo_motor_model.h:107; src/gazebo_motor_model.cpp:282-298), but a 0 publication is not a source-backed acknowledged ROS safe state, and RosDriver safe-state bindings must be a service or action (MHS/sdk/docs/ros-driver.md:36-37, 78-92). The nested external/OpticalFlow submodule (gitlink 28ef45c1fcb532b2bfd54c16b059c6a545143b2f at the parent pin; its own klt_feature_tracker gitlink is 9b5b567ae77f93d1ef4d36151529ba2506a46e7a) contains one ROS 1 service, track_features (external/OpticalFlow/external/klt_feature_tracker/src/nodes/feature_tracker_node.cpp:55), taking two sensor_msgs/Image inputs and returning feature coordinates (external/OpticalFlow/external/klt_feature_tracker/srv/TrackFeatures.srv:1-8). It is a separate repository at its own pin, a perception computation rather than the simulator's MAVLink control or step interface, and it advertises no stop or safe-state service (the node only advertises track_features and spins at :55-59).

ROS 1 MODEL FRAGMENTS: models/fpv_cam/fpv_cam.sdf:68, models/c920/c920.sdf.jinja:68, models/depth_camera/depth_camera.sdf.jinja:52 and models/rplidar/model.sdf:49 configure the external libgazebo_ros_camera.so/libgazebo_ros_laser.so. The parent source tree does not declare sensor_msgs/Image or sensor_msgs/LaserScan; those types and callbacks are in the external gazebo_ros package (package.xml:41-63), and the SDF only gives relative parameters such as <imageTopicName>image_raw</imageTopicName> (models/fpv_cam/fpv_cam.sdf:71). A metadata-only camera/lidar driver would replace the primary MAVLink/environment-step interface with sensor observations, which the task forbids. The parent source does not declare the camera publisher's ROS type; the SDF only names the external libgazebo_ros_camera.so/libgazebo_ros_laser.so plugin and relative parameters, so the type would have to be cited from an external package, not this repository.

OTHER INTERFACES: all other control and sensor paths are Gazebo transport topics or custom protobuf messages under msgs/ (topic constants at include/gazebo_mavlink_interface.h:111-120 and include/gazebo_motor_model.h:50-52; msgs/*.proto). None is ROS and none has a rosbridge type.

WHY NO DIRECT DRIVER: the pinned tree has no Python device class; git ls-tree HEAD contains only scripts/jinja_gen.py, scripts/names.py and scripts/substitution_args.py, none a device API. G7 needs a Python native class (or a pyfile: selector) in the clone; inventing one or a native.py factory would fabricate the native surface. GymnasiumDriver and MujocoDriver do not apply: no environment registration, action space, reward or MuJoCo model. The in-clone step/reset/pause controls are not declared; Gazebo's ROS pause/reset services belong to the external gazebo_ros package and cannot be cited from this clone.

SAFETY: any effectful RosDriver over this surface would expose a one-way publication with no source-backed acknowledged stop. The runtime would latch and then report MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED (MHS/sdk/docs/ros-driver.md:87-92), and G6/SAFE-028 would fail. A zero-number publication is not accepted as a stop. This is a genuine upstream stop gap, not a fake feature.

GATE: one baseline run was made with only task.json present (2026-11-05T00:46:43-08:00, backend fake). It reports G1.MISSING_FILE for driver.py, driver.lock.json and test_driver.py, G2.NO_LOCK, G3.IMPORT "driver.py is missing", and G9.MISSING; G4-G8 are NOT_RUN. That run only confirms no package was authored. No honest driver.py/fake.py can be built from this interface, so no further gate runs were consumed.

ISOLATION: the clone at 807b67bb3007113ea52fd36ec2cefae4a5fa3f85 was not modified: the G1 layout step reported no CLONE_MODIFIED or CLONE_WRITTEN, and no file was written under robots/px4/px4-sitl_gazebo-classic. No upstream code was imported or run, no network or pip install was used, and no hardware or ROS graph was attached.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's family:ros/RosDriver cannot express the MAVLink/Gazebo transport runtime; no shape can be selected, and this package needs separate routing for a non-ROS SITL/Gazebo transport helper. NOT COVERED: all simulator, MAVLink, Gazebo transport, ROS plugin, sensor, camera, GStreamer and deployment behavior, because the package stops before implementation.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block (HELPER_MISSING; no package code): the pin is the PX4 Gazebo Classic plugin suite for MAVLink SITL and HITL with no dependency on ROS (README.md:1-12); its control path is the GazeboMavlinkInterface plugin over UDP, TCP or serial MAVLink, its other topics are Gazebo transport, and its only ROS code is an optional ROS 2 motor-failure plugin (BUILD_ROS2_PLUGINS OFF, CMakeLists.txt:40) with no stop. The card's family ros comes from package.xml build dependencies; the override proposal skips the card, as for ardupilot_gazebo: vehicles fly through PX4 over MAVLink (gh.px4/px4-autopilot). No authored file changed; the gate re-run rewrote check-report.json (G1, G2, G3, G9 fail; stable digest sha256:25609907b2f1ad92b53f6a57eef26a27e29dabc9f12d619438da4230607c77f0). The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: HITL mode talks MAVLink over a serial port to a real flight controller (serialEnabled, serialDevice; gazebo_mavlink_interface.cpp:331-334, 516-523): any future package must keep it out of scope or treat it as hardware.
